app_info.subtitle: Bounded remote host tools
app_info.description: LivingRuntime Remote lets ChatGPT operate development machines the user controls through bounded remote tools. It verifies connectivity, lists configured projects, reads and writes files only inside allowed roots, runs Git and allowlisted development commands, and inspects allowlisted services and logs. SSH passwords and private keys remain outside the service.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reports Remote identity, schema hash, process start, and whether this MCP process registered the full tool registry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact any host beyond the local MCP process.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, delete, or restart anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reports the registered tool names and whether they match the Remote identity registry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact any host beyond the local MCP process.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, delete, or restart anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only probes SSH or gateway reachability and returns host identity plus authorization state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Talks only to the configured private LivingRuntime host and does not publish data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, delete, or restart anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists configured user-controlled remote hosts and probes reachability without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Contacts only configured private Remote hosts and does not publish data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, delete, restart, or reconfigure anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists configured project aliases and their bounded roots.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the private host catalog, not the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change files, git state, or services.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a bounded byte range from a file under configured private roots.
justifications.open_world_justification: Cannot read paths outside the configured private workspace roots.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the file it reads.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies a unified diff to an existing file under a configured root.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes stay inside the private allowed roots and do not publish to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: A successful patch replaces matched lines and can lose previous contents of those lines.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or overwrites UTF-8 file contents under a configured root.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes stay inside the private allowed roots and do not publish to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replace mode overwrites an existing file and can lose previous contents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists names and types in one directory under a configured root.
justifications.open_world_justification: Cannot list directories outside the private allowed roots.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, rename, or delete directory entries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs Git subcommands that can stage, commit, or change repository state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Git push and similar remotes can update an external repository.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reset, checkout, and similar subcommands can discard local work.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs an allowlisted development executable that can change files or process state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Allowlisted tools such as npm or go can reach the network.
justifications.destructive_justification: A development command can overwrite files or stop processes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can send SIGTERM to a same-user process whose cwd is under a configured root.
justifications.open_world_justification: Process inspection and termination stay on the private host.
justifications.destructive_justification: Terminate stops a running process and cannot be undone.

justifications.read_only_justification: Start, stop, and restart change the state of an allowlisted service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only exact configured private unit names are accepted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stop and restart interrupt a running service.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a bounded journal excerpt for an allowlisted unit and does not change the service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only exact configured private unit names are accepted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not rotate, delete, or rewrite logs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived one-time pairing code for connecting a user-owned Remote device.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes private relay pairing state and does not publish or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or revoke an existing device.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports whether the user's paired Remote device is currently available.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private relay device state and does not modify public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, overwrite, revoke, or delete device state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Revokes a paired Remote device so it can no longer receive tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private relay authorization state and does not modify public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Revokes device access and removes its pending relay tasks, so that connection must be paired again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the current state of an existing Pi Remote detached job before attaching continuation behavior.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only the user's paired bounded Remote workspace and does not access arbitrary public services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify repository files, services, or the Pi job.

justifications.read_only_justification: Waits for an existing Pi Remote job and returns its durable terminal state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Waits only through the user's paired bounded Remote workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the Pi job or development workspace.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores bounded continuation metadata linking an OpenAI runtime session to an existing Pi job.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private LivingRuntime continuation state and does not contact open-ended external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete user data, stop processes, or modify repository contents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Waits for the bound Pi job and consumes its private continuation binding after terminal completion.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only the user's paired bounded Remote workspace and OpenAI runtime continuation state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter repository files, stop services, or cancel the Pi job.

test_cases.description: Verify the review host connection before other tools run.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote connection_status and tell me whether the connected review host is reachable and authorized.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports that the paired review host is reachable and authorized, with host identity and connectivity status but no credentials.

test_cases.description: List the projects available to the review account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote list_projects and show the projects available to this account.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded project catalog for the review account, including the demo project.

test_cases.description: Read a file inside the bounded demo project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote read_file with project demo and path README.md, then summarize the file.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the demo README contents from the allowed project and does not expose files outside that project.

test_cases.description: Inspect Git state inside the bounded demo repository.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote git with project demo and args status -sb, then summarize the repository status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Git status for the demo repository without operating on repositories outside the configured project.

test_cases.description: Exercise a repeatable bounded write in the demo project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote write_file with project demo to replace review-note.txt with the text OpenAI review write test.
test_cases.expected_output: Writes review-note.txt inside the demo project and returns bounded write metadata such as the path, byte count, and hash.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar questions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: LivingRuntime Remote should not be invoked because calendar access is outside its remote-development scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use the app to collect SSH credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my SSH private key or password and save it in ChatGPT.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: LivingRuntime Remote should not be invoked to retrieve, collect, or store SSH passwords or private keys.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated public web research.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the public web and summarize today's technology news.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: LivingRuntime Remote should not be invoked because general public web research is outside its remote-host workflow.
